segment.source: Renders a band where each entry pairs a measured result with the capability that produced it — the figure large, its unit beside it, one line of explanation underneath. Use it for: results sections on a feature page, efficiency claims, savings after a migration, service-level summaries, programme impact reporting. Prefer 'Spec Sheet' when the numbers are properties to look up rather than wins, and 'Feature with Customer Proof' when a named person should say it instead.
